Outsider (Earth) · SM -1 Salt Mephit (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5)

A chalk-white mephit of salt crystal veined with pale rose, with heavy halite wings. It is drier than anything nearby has any right to be, cracks audibly when struck, and breathes a burst of crystals that draws the water out of whatever they land on.

Breath WeaponBreath Weapon (13): A 10-yard jet of salt crystals erupts from the mephit’s mouth. It uses Innate Attack (Breath) to hit. Don’t apply range penalties; treat this as a long melee weapon rather than a ranged attack. It does 1d small piercing damage, and has a 1/2D range of 5 yards. If any damage penetrates the target’s DR, he must make a HT roll, at -1 per 2 points of injury or suffer from itching skin and eyes for (20 – HT) minutes. The target is at -2 to DX for the duration of the itch. Scratching for one full second relieves the itch, but the target can do nothing else while scratching. Drain MoistureBy spending 4 FP, a salt mephit can drain moisture from the area around him. Every creature within 4 yards of him takes 1d fatigue damage. Treat FP lost to the attack identically to FP lost to dehydration for all purposes, notably recovery.—1d fatigue4 yards
